records.title: ASIP Cohort 4: Building practical infrastructure for African markets
records.summary: Meet the ten ventures selected for ASIP's fourth accelerator cohort and the market problems they are working to solve.
records.body_html:
ASIP Accelerator Cohort 4 brought together ten ventures working across health, financial technology, clean energy, education, agriculture, logistics, and construction technology.

A pan-African selection

The selection process reviewed applications from 52 countries. The final cohort included companies from Côte d'Ivoire, Egypt, Nigeria, Senegal, Tanzania, and Uganda.

Solutions grounded in everyday needs

The cohort's work ranges from solar-powered cold storage and community energy pods to hospital digitisation, education finance, last-mile delivery, and offline-capable payments. Each company entered the programme with a defined operating challenge and evidence of early market activity.

The cohort

10mg Pharma, Babimo, BETAPAWA Solutions, Edusko, KoriTech, LyfPlus, Messenger, Munakyalo Agrofresh, Ostafandy, and Primed E-Health formed the fourth ASIP accelerator cohort.

records.title: ASIP Cohort 3: Eleven founders across eight African markets
records.summary: A look at the third ASIP accelerator cohort, its regional reach, and the sectors represented by eleven selected companies.
records.body_html:
ASIP's third accelerator cohort selected eleven companies following Final Selection Days in January 2023.

Regional reach

The cohort connected founders from Ghana, Kenya, Mali, Morocco, Nigeria, Senegal, Uganda, and Côte d'Ivoire. Their companies represented agritech, supply chains, financial technology, connectivity, clean technology, machine learning, digital health, and cybersecurity.

The cohort

BD Waste, CargoPlug, Chestify AI, Kyanda, Limawa, Moja Ride, Parkwell, PharmaServ, SafeTrack, Sodishop, and Yoonema joined the programme.

From selection to Demo Day

The programme combined structured acceleration with founder support, ecosystem access, and preparation for presenting each venture's model, traction, and growth plans.

records.title: ASIP Cohort 2: Acceleration and ecosystem connection in Dakar
records.summary: How ASIP's second cohort combined digital acceleration with in-person programme support in Senegal.
records.body_html:
ASIP Accelerator Cohort 2 combined the Accelerator Squared digital platform with in-person programme support in Dakar.

Eleven selected companies

The cohort included AgroData, Crowdyvest, eCampus, EcoMak Recyclers, Neural Labs Africa, ParcSmart, Powerstove Energy, ProXalys, Qataloog, Rural Farmers Hub, and Vooli.

A broad sector mix

The selected ventures worked across agriculture and supply chains, connectivity, clean technology, financial technology, machine learning, digital health, cybersecurity, education, and insurance.

Building programme connections

The cohort format connected founders with programme delivery, mentors, partners, and opportunities to sharpen their businesses ahead of Demo Day.

records.title: ASIP Cohort 1: Launching a pan-African accelerator
records.summary: The first ASIP cohort established a fully virtual accelerator connecting eleven ventures across African markets.
records.body_html:
ASIP's first cohort launched as a fully virtual, three-month accelerator powered by Startupbootcamp AfriTech.

Pan-African participation

The programme selected eleven companies working across agriculture, healthcare, logistics, financial services, clean energy, and digital platforms.

The founding cohort

Agrix Tech, AgroData, AGS Tribe, Chekkit Technologies, Dawa Health, Motito, NucleusIS, Thumeza, uStacky, Weza Ventures, and Worldbay Technologies formed the first ASIP cohort.

A foundation for future chapters

The virtual programme created a repeatable platform for connecting founders to structured acceleration, mentors, corporate partners, and investor-facing opportunities.
